transcript: So what business would you start if you had unlimited funds? Well, first of all, I'd probably start a business that doesn't require any funds. And for me, that would be reaching out to a business owner that's about five years old and asking them if they have any old leads that we can turn into sales or book appointments with. And if they don't get paid, we don't get paid. It's a pretty simple offer. No one really says no to it. It's a no-brainer offer, really. How can you trust the clients are gonna pay you for that? Well, what you can do is get access to their CRM, which is incredibly easy these days. Read-only access. Number two, I guess you wanna work with clients that you can trust and trust you, because if they stop paying you, then you pull what you do for them and they lose all of this found money that they never had before. It's like a no-brainer offer.
